inputRootSignature: theorem doubly_robust_mean_identification_under_mar {Ω 𝒵 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype 𝒵] [MeasurableSpace 𝒵] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝒵] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (R : Ω → Bool) (Z : Ω → 𝒵) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (hRmeas : Measurable R) (hZmeas : Measurable Z) (hYmeas : Measurable Y) (hYint : Integrable Y P) (hZpos : ∀ z, 0 < P {ω | Z ω = z}) (hMAR : ∀ (B : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet B → ∀ r z, P {ω | Y ω ∈ B ∧ R ω = r ∧ Z ω = z} * P {ω | Z ω = z} = P {ω | Y ω ∈ B ∧ Z ω = z} * P {ω | R ω = r ∧ Z ω = z}) (m : 𝒵 → ℝ) (π : 𝒵 → ℝ) (hπpos : ∀ z, 0 < π z) (hπle : ∀ z, π z ≤ 1) : let m0 : 𝒵 → ℝ := fun z ↦ (∫ ω in {ω | Z ω = z}, Y ω ∂P) / (P {ω | Z ω = z}).toReal let π0 : 𝒵 → ℝ := fun z ↦ (P {ω | R ω = true ∧ Z ω = z}).toReal / (P {ω | Z ω = z}).toReal (∀ z, 0 < π0 z) → (m = m0 ∨ π = π0) → ∫ ω, m (Z ω) + (if R ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / π (Z ω) * (Y ω - m (Z ω)) ∂P = ∫ ω, Y ω ∂P
